info.title: Zscaler Private Access API Portal
info.description: To access detailed ZPA API documentation, including references and use cases, refer to the [Zscaler Help Portal](/zpa/about-zpa-api).

get.summary: Gets all configured privileged approvals for the specified customer.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: The sort string used to support sorting on the given field for the API.

parameters.name: sortdir
parameters.description: Specifies the sort direction (i.e., ascending or descending order).

parameters.name: microtenantId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained in the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations are limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

startTime.description: The start date that the user has access to the privileged approval.

endTime.description: The end date that the user no longer has access to the privileged approval.

status.description:
The status of the privileged approval. The supported values are:
  • INVALID: The privileged approval is invalid.
  • ACTIVE: The privileged approval is currently available for the user.
  • FUTURE: The privileged approval is avialable for a user at a set time in the future.
  • EXPIRED: The privileged approval is no longer available for the user.

emailIds.description: The email address of the user that you are assigning the privileged approval to. You can assign only one email address to the privileged approval.

startTimeCron.description: The cron expression provided to configure the privileged approval start time working hours. The standard cron expression format is [Seconds][Minutes][Hours][Day of the Month][Month][Day of the Week][Year]. For example, 0 15 10 ? * MON-FRI represents the start time working hours for 10:15 AM every Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

endTimeCron.description: The cron expression provided to configure the privileged approval end time working hours. The standard cron expression format is [Seconds][Minutes][Hours][Day of the Month][Month][Day of the Week][Year]. For example, 0 15 10 ? * MON-FRI represents the end time working hours for 10:15 AM every Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

startTime.description: The start time that the user has access to the privileged approval.

endTime.description: The end time that the user no longer has access to the privileged approval.

days.description: The days of the week that you want to enable the privileged approval.

timeZone.description: The time zone for the time window of a privileged approval.

id.description: The unique identifier of the application.

modifiedTime.description: The time the application is modified.

creationTime.description: The time the application is modified.

modifiedBy.description: The unique identifier of the tenant who modified the application.

items.description: The list of Microtenants shared to this application and their IDs.

domainNames.description: The list of domains and IP addresses. The maximum limit for domains or IP addresses is 2,000 applications per application segment. The maximum limit for domains or IP addresses for the whole customer is 6,000 applications.

defaultIdleTimeout.description: The duration of the default idle timeout.

defaultMaxAge.description: The default maximum age of the resource.

enabled.description: Whether or not the application is enabled.

passiveHealthEnabled.description: Indicates if passive health checks are enabled on the application.

items.description: The list of TCP port ranges used to access the application.
The list of UDP port ranges used to access the application.

doubleEncrypt.description: Indicates if Double Encryption is enabled (true) or disabled (false) for the application.

healthCheckType.description: Whether the health check is enabled (DEFAULT) or disabled (NONE) for the application.

icmpAccessType.description: The ICMP access type of the application.

bypassType.description: Indicates the bypass type when users bypass ZPA to access applications.

configSpace.description: Indicates if the configuration is created as part of the SIEM or application resource.

ipAnchored.description: Whether Source IP Anchoring for use with ZIA is enabled (true) or disabled (false) for the application.

bypassOnReauth.description: Indiciates if application access during reauthentication bypasses ZPA (Enabled) or not (Disabled). For example, if your IdP is configured to do multi-factor authentication (MFA) for off-premises users, enabling this option redirects the user to the IdP via the internet where the IdP prompts the user for MFA. For on-premises users, enabling this option redirects the user to the IdP via the internet where the IdP prompts them for MFA. This feature requires versions Zscaler Client Connector 4.3 or later for Windows and macOS.

inspectTrafficWithZia.description: Enable to leverage single posture for securing internet or SaaS and private applications and apply Data Loss Prevention policies to the application segment you are creating. If Source IP Anchor is enabled, you must disable it prior to enabling Inspect Traffic with ZIA as both features cannot be enabled at the same time.

tcpKeepAlive.description: Indicates if TCP Keep Alive is enabled (1) or disabled (0) for the application segment.

useInDrMode.description: Whether or not the application is designated for disaster recovery.

matchStyle.description: Indicates if Multimatch is enabled for the application segment. If enabled (INCLUSIVE), the request allows traffic to match multiple applications. If disabled (EXCLUSIVE), the request allows traffic to match a single application. A domain can only be INCLUSIVE or EXCLUSIVE, and any application segment can only contain inclusive or exclusive domains.

serverGroups.description: The list of server groups and their IDs.

selectConnectorCloseToApp.description: Whether the App Connector is closest to the application (true) or closest to the user (false).

weightedLoadBalancing.description: Indicates if the application load balancing configuration for application segments is enabled (true) or disabled (false).

extranetEnabled.description: Indiciates if the application is designated for Extranet Application Support (true) or not (false). Extranet applications connect to a partner site or offshore development center that is not directly available on your organization’s network.

tcpProtocolsBitmasks.description: The set of TCP protocols used by this application in the form of an array of bitmasks.

udpProtocolsBitmasks.description: The set of UDP protocols used by this application in the form of an array of bitmasks.

adpEnabled.description: Indicates if Active Directory Inspection is enabled or not for the application. This allows the application segment's traffic to be inspected by Active Directory (AD) Protection. By default, this field is set to false. If adpEnabled is set to true, then the field matchStyle must be set to EXCLUSIVE. If adpEnabled is set to true, then autoAppProtectEnabled cannot be set to true.

apiProtectionEnabled.description: If set to true, designates the application segment for API traffic inspection.

autoAppProtectEnabled.description: If autoAppProtectEnabled is set to true, this field indicates if the application segment’s traffic is inspected by AppProtection. If set to true, a valid AppProtection enrollment certificate must be generated to inspect application segment traffic by AppProtection. If adpEnabled is set to true for Active Directory Inspection, then autoAppProtectEnabled cannot be true.

fqdnDnsCheck.description: If set to true, performs a DNS check to find an A or AAAA record for this application.

tcpPortRange.description: The list of TCP port ranges used to access the application.

udpPortRange.description: The UDP port ranges used to access the application.

enabled.description: Whether or not the server group is enabled.

dynamicDiscovery.description: Controls dynamic discovery of the servers.

description.description: The description of the server group.

configSpace.description: Indicates if the configuration is created as part of the SIEM or application resource.

weight.description: The weight of the load balancing configuration. Weights with a lower value indicate that a lesser number of requests are served by the App Connectors linked to the server group. Weights with a higher value than other server groups indicate that the App Connectors linked to the server group serve a greater number of requests. Server groups with weights set to 0 do not route requests.

passive.description: Indicates if the server groups are in an active state and can load balance (false), or if the server groups stay passive (true).

extranetEnabled.description: Inidicates if Extranet Application Support is enabled for the server group. These field is only applicable for server group endpoints, and is not applicable for Policy Set or Policy Rule endpoints.

modifiedTime.description: The time the extranet resource is modified.

creationTime.description: The time the extranet resource is created.

ziaErId.description: The unique identifier of the extranet resource created in ZIA.

ziaErName.description: The name of the extranet resource created in ZIA.

ziaCloud.description: The ZIA cloud of the extranet resource.

ziaOrgId.description: The unique identifier of the organization for the extranet resource.
